run_independent_calibration_pipeline: run the IndependentPipeline to calibrate a model using independent calibration epochs per modifier
create_calibration_pipeline_independent: create an IndependentPipeline registered under the CalibrationPipeline registry with name 'independent'
test_independent_pipeline_call: test the IndependentPipeline.__call__ method with a model, dataloader, and dataset arguments
refactor_independent_pipeline_modifiers: refactor the IndependentPipeline to iterate over recipe modifiers and assign each its own calibration pipeline
summarize_independent_pipeline: summarize the IndependentPipeline which assigns each modifier its own calibration epoch and data pipeline
